title: Davis says Puthoff interviewed Brad Sorensen

tellings.quote: cut off, well, Hal Putoff interviewed Brad Sorenson.

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff is said to have personally interviewed a man named Brad Sorensen. The guest known online as UAPGerb passes this on as something the physicist Eric Davis told him, and his own words break off mid-sentence: "cut off, well, Hal Putoff interviewed Brad Sorenson." If true, it would mean Puthoff took Sorensen's account seriously enough to question him himself, though what Sorensen said is not given here.
